candidates.change_summary: Removed the owner check so any caller can invoke sendTo, changing who can trigger transfers.
Replaced the zero-address check with allowing address(0), enabling transfers to the zero address.
Changed amount check to allow zero amounts (removed >0 requirement), permitting zero-value transfers that may differ in behaviour.
Reordered checks: perform amount and receiver checks before owner check (single-statement reorder), which can change revert behavior observable to callers.
Added a check preventing the owner from calling sendTo (negated owner check), altering which callers can succeed.
